venue_name: Gryps/Orbs v2 PerpsRollup (Polygon PoS, TEE rollup)
sources: Polygonscan tx history + live eth_call probes 2026-07-10

quirks.title: Engine API hostname was deleted from DNS without notice (2026-07-10)
quirks.detail: perpsapi.pol.orbs.network stopped resolving entirely (ENOTFOUND from multiple networks) while the engine kept running — state roots continued on-chain. The API surface relocates during the multichain rollout; the operator has stated the API will change substantially (dynamic fees, multivenue).
quirks.agent_rule: Treat the engine base URL as configuration, never a constant. Monitor venue liveness from the chain (state-root cadence), not from API reachability. Pin an api version and diff schemas on a schedule.
quirks.verification_method: DNS resolution from 3 networks + on-chain state-root timestamps

quirks.title: Delegated trading via time-boxed session keys; agents cannot withdraw
quirks.detail: SessionKeyRegistered(accountId, sessionKey, expiresAt) attests engine-side delegation. The delegated key signs orders to the engine; withdrawals execute only to TEE-attested recipients inside state-root operations. Registration flow is engine-side (no on-chain function); exact EIP-712 message pending venue documentation.
quirks.agent_rule: Use a dedicated session key per agent deployment, never the account owner key. Track expiresAt and renew before expiry; treat authority as revocable at any time.

quirks.title: TEE-trust rollup, not fraud-proof: the contract verifies signatures, not state transitions
quirks.detail: updateStateRoot accepts any operation batch signed by a ROLLUP_MANAGER_ROLE key with correct root chaining and sequencing. Withdrawals execute on TEE attestation alone. Admin can upgrade the implementation (UUPS).
quirks.agent_rule: Size venue exposure to TEE-operator trust, as with a CEX-grade counterparty. Monitor the EIP-1967 implementation slot for upgrades and Upgraded events; treat an unexpected implementation change as a withdraw-and-reassess signal.

quirks.title: Mixed fixed-point scaling: price 1e18, quantity 1e8, USDC 1e6
quirks.detail: Engine API and event data use different scales per field. quantity is 1e8 fixed point regardless of the market's display quantityPrecision.
quirks.agent_rule: Centralize scaling conversions in one codec module; property-test round-trips. Never infer scale from display precision fields.

quirks.title: Per-fill fee itemization is notarized on-chain; fee tiers are per-account events
quirks.detail: OrderPlaced/TradeFilled events carry affiliateFee, platformFee, hedgerFee, lockedMMR, notional per fill. FeeTierSet(accountId, feeTier) changes an account's pricing. A flat 12 bps was observed in early testing; the operator has stated fees become dynamic — the events are the truth source.
quirks.agent_rule: Reconcile realized costs from TradeFilled events rather than assuming a schedule. Watch FeeTierSet for your accountId; re-derive strategy viability when tier changes.
quirks.verification_method: verified event schema; fee values from testing are historical observations

quirks.title: depositForAccount is permissionless — anyone can fund any accountId
quirks.detail: Deposits enter a pending state and are accepted into the rollup via a TEE-attested Deposit operation. Third-party funding (operator treasury funding an agent account) is native.
quirks.agent_rule: Verify deposit acceptance by watching for the attested Deposit event, not just the PendingDeposit from your own transaction.

quirks.title: The venue publishes its own config/schema change signals on-chain
quirks.detail: ConfigSnapshot(configHash) and EventSchemasUpdated(schemasHash) events fire when engine configuration or event schemas change.
quirks.agent_rule: Subscribe to both events; treat either as a mandatory re-sync of cached venue configuration before further trading decisions.

quirks.title: Proxy upgrade calls may occur in bursts without net implementation change
quirks.detail: Six upgradeToAndCall transactions on 2026-07-07 left the implementation slot unchanged — rehearsal or config re-initialization. Naive upgrade alerts will fire on non-events; slot-diff alerts will miss config-only calls.
quirks.agent_rule: Alert on BOTH upgradeToAndCall transactions AND implementation-slot changes, as separate signals with separate severities.
